Without this, the browser sees app.vercel.app calling api.onrender.com —
a cross-SITE request, so the session cookies are third-party. Safari blocks
those by default and Chrome is phasing them out, which means login would
appear to work and then every subsequent request would arrive with no
cookie. Setting SameSite=None does not help: it is precisely the flag
those browsers are refusing to honour cross-site.
Rewriting server-side makes the request first-party from the browser's
point of view, so cookies can stay SameSite=Lax and behave normally with
